cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may join my plan for Denise's surprise leaving party. I need her out of the office at seven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I skip washing glasses this time?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exemption granted. I'll wash. You are being considered for the more distinguished coffee diversion.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She won't leave until I finish her spreadsheet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I authorize you to delegate it to me. Take her for coffee; you may complain about my work if she starts getting suspicious.

reason: Let B practical requests reshape recruitment while A insists on authorizing even personal labor and the cover story.
